privacy.s1_text: Par Cristão (Christian Match) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you share with us. This policy describes how we collect, use and protect your information.
privacy.s2_li1: Profile Information: Name, age, photos, religious denomination and description.
privacy.s2_li2: Usage Data: Interactions with other users, matches and messages.
privacy.s2_li3: Technical Data: IP address, device type and operating system.
privacy.s2_extra: We collect information about your religious denomination strictly to connect you with compatible profiles, in accordance with the app's purpose.
privacy.s2b_text: To enable the connection between compatible profiles, Par Cristão collects and processes sensitive personal data — specifically your religious belief (denomination) and your approximate geolocation. This data is processed exclusively for the purpose of suggesting profiles aligned with your faith and geographic proximity, and only with your free, informed and unequivocal consent, collected at registration. You may revoke this consent at any time in the app settings, noting that revocation may limit essential service features.
privacy.s2c_text: Par Cristão offers profile verification through a gesture selfie, which grants the user a verified profile badge (blue badge). The captured image is processed as biometric data (LGPD, Art. 5, II) and is used exclusively for identity verification and fraud prevention. Processing of this data occurs only with the user's specific and explicit consent, requested before capture. The verification selfie is stored securely and is not shared with third parties, and may be deleted at any time upon the user's request.
privacy.s3_li2: Suggest compatible matches based on your denomination and preferences.
privacy.s3_li3: Ensure platform security and prevent fraud.
privacy.s3_li4: Improve our services and develop new features.
privacy.s4_intro: We do not sell your personal data. We share information only:
privacy.s4_li1: With other users as part of the app's functionality (your public profile).
privacy.s4_li2: When required by law or judicial authority.
privacy.s5_text: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration or destruction.
privacy.s6_text: You have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data at any time through the app settings or by contacting us.
privacy.s6b_text: If you no longer have access to the app and wish to permanently delete your account and all associated data, you can request deletion by sending an email to dualis.love.app@gmail.com with the subject "Account Deletion". The request must be sent from the same email address used in the original registration. Your account and data will be permanently removed within 7 business days after identity confirmation.
privacy.s7_text: In compliance with the General Data Protection Law (Lei nº 13.709/2018 — LGPD), we inform that questions, requests or complaints related to the processing of your personal data may be directed to our Data Protection Officer (DPO), João Paulo do Couto, at: dualis.love.app@gmail.com.
privacy.s8_text: We may update this policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes through the app.

terms.s1_text: By downloading, installing or using the Par Cristão app ("Service"), you agree to comply with these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any of these terms, you should not use the app.
terms.s2_text: Par Cristão is a platform designed to promote friendships and serious relationships among members of the Christian community. All users are expected to maintain respectful conduct aligned with Christian values.
terms.s3_text: To use Par Cristão, you must be at least 18 years old and have full legal capacity. By creating an account, you declare and warrant that you meet these requirements.
terms.s4_li1: Use the service for illegal or unauthorized purposes.
terms.s4_li2: Post offensive, defamatory, obscene content or content that violates third-party rights.
terms.s4_li3: Harass, intimidate or stalk other users.
terms.s4_li4: Create fake profiles or impersonate another person.
terms.s5_text: Your privacy is important to us. Please refer to our Privacy Policy to understand how we collect and use your data. We recommend caution when sharing personal information with other users.
terms.s6_text: You can delete your account and all associated data directly through the app settings. If you no longer have access to the app, deletion can be requested remotely by sending an email to dualis.love.app@gmail.com with the subject "Account Deletion", using the same email address from the original registration. The request will be processed within 7 business days.
terms.s7_text: We reserve the right to modify or discontinue the service at any time, temporarily or permanently, with or without notice.
terms.s8_text: If you have questions about these terms, contact us through the app's official channels or via the Data Protection Officer (DPO), João Paulo do Couto, email: dualis.love.app@gmail.com.
